# Apollo Federation v2 SDL — auth-subgraph
# Release: v1.0.0
# Feature references: FEAT-2 (SSO login button and OAuth callback flow)
#
# This file contains ONLY the schema additions/changes introduced in this release.
# The full composed supergraph is generated by Rover CLI — do not hand-author it.
#
# Cross-subgraph references:
#   order-subgraph references User entity — see order-subgraph.api.graphql
#
# Implementation target: ./servers/auth-subgraph/src/schema/

extend schema
  @link(url: "https://specs.apollo.dev/federation/v2.0", import: [
    "@key",
    "@shareable",
    "@external",
    "@requires",
    "@provides",
    "@override",
    "@inaccessible"
  ])

# ─── Entity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"""
Authenticated user entity. Owned by auth-subgraph.
Other subgraphs reference this entity via @key(fields: "id").
"""
type User @key(fields: "id") {
  id: ID!
  email: String!
  displayName: String!
  ssoProvider: SSOProvider
  createdAt: DateTime!
}

# ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

"""
SSO provider configuration for an authenticated user.
"""
type SSOProvider @shareable {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  domain: String!
}

"""
Response from initiating an SSO login flow.
Contains the redirect URL and CSRF state token.
"""
type SSOLoginResponse {
  redirectUrl: String!

  """
  CSRF state token. Must be validated on callback.
  """
  state: String!
}

"""
Authenticated session returned after successful SSO login.
"""
type AuthSession {
  token: String!
  refreshToken: String!
  expiresAt: DateTime!
  user: User!
}

# ─── Mutations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

extend type Mutation {
  """
  Initiate SSO login flow.
  Returns a redirect URL for the SSO provider and a CSRF state token.
  """
  initiateSSOLogin(
    """ID of the SSO provider to authenticate against."""
    providerId: ID!
  ): SSOLoginResponse!

  """
  Complete SSO login by exchanging the OAuth callback code for an authenticated session.
  The state param must match the value returned by initiateSSOLogin.
  """
  completeSSOLogin(
    """OAuth authorization code from the SSO provider callback."""
    code: String!

    """CSRF state token from initiateSSOLogin. Must match to prevent CSRF attacks."""
    state: String!
  ): AuthSession!
}

# ─── Scalars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

scalar DateTime
